claim: At runtime (probe api_surface.lua, six states: front end, campaign, campaign with a character selected, land, siege, naval) all of J6's new names exist (CampaignUI 28, BattleUI 11, FrontEnd 16) and most 'gone' names still exist (CampaignUI 6 of 8, BattleUI 4 of 16, FrontEnd 10 of 12: present in the exe, unused by vanilla scripts); TriggerAnimation, ShaderTechniqueGet and SetZDepth are UIComponent methods in every state; OnDraw, OnPreDraw and OnAnimationFrameEnd are layout callbacks, not in any Lua table; of the 38 argument-count drifts 11 are real engine changes, 5 are not (optional arguments, pass-through, a stub), 22 are script-defined functions (discovery/napoleon/lua_cfuncs.json); the build-system names (buildcommands, project, ...) are not engine API
notes: 34 of the 44 new component methods were not reached: multiplayer, chat and drop-in objects absent from single-player states
